interpretation: Faithful original QKV bytes plus identical embedding/norm locate this measured first difference inside the ordinary BF16 projection. This is a causal localization, not a numerical bug verdict.

For channels extremely close to a BF16 midpoint, a small unobserved F32 accumulation change can select neighboring BF16 values. The exact-dot FP32-then-BF16 reference distinguishes double rounding of the ideal sum from arithmetic error accumulated before the final conversion.

The native kernel exposes only BF16 C. Its actual F32 accumulator, selected heuristic ID and partial reduction tree were not captured. Therefore this report cannot certify that either output was produced by a particular legal F32 order or prove an illegal cuBLAS computation.

The two small cancellation-sensitive outputs require special care: relative/BF16-ULP differences can be large while absolute dot error is small; neither small absolute error nor ill-conditioning is a model-quality acceptance test.

No precision/provider/sampler policy, threshold, product source or native experiment is changed here. The separately observed four-arm complex-sort failures are auxiliary model-task observations, not a new MTP completion gate or proof that MTP introduced the task failure.

existing_regression_contract.reference_note: Reuse the existing test tolerance formula exactly. The original test accumulates a sequential double expected; this audit independently uses the requested math.fsum dot, without first rounding expected to BF16.

f32_necessary_bound.exact_reference: Original BF16 significands and powers of two are accumulated as exact integers/rationals for dot and sumabs; each shape also has an independent FP64 math.fsum dot.
f32_necessary_bound.addition_model: Ideal round-to-nearest F32 with gradual underflow and no overflow. The common product quantum is at least2^-149, so any subnormal intermediate sum on that lattice is exactly representable; this does not establish vendor FTZ/DAZ or internal precision behavior.
f32_necessary_bound.interpretation: A necessary compatibility condition for the stated idealized F32 summation bound plus BF16 RNE, not evidence that a vendor implements a particular legal reduction algorithm. Comparing the rounded BF16 center directly to a pure F32 bound would omit final rounding. Numerical zero cells combine signed zeros.

limits: Only the already exported first projection row0 is assessed. No model/task quality, downstream error amplification, all-shape tolerance or cross-backend equality is signed.
